concerns.text: T002 and T011 enforce 'ABORT on failure' for 4-bit quantization, but plan.md Constraints and T024 allow 'fallback to 8-bit or full precision'. This contradicts Constitution Principle VII and FR-002 which mandate strict 4-bit quantization with NO fallback to preserve statistical validity.

T018 and T024 reference 'max [deferred]' methods per repository, whereas FR-001 and Constitution Principle VII explicitly mandate a hard cap of 1,000 methods. Using a placeholder here silently relaxes the deterministic generation constraint required for the 6-hour runtime guarantee.

T011 requires asserting claim identifier '{{claim:c_1990dc9b}}' which does not exist in spec.md, plan.md, or constitution.md. This creates a broken traceability link and implies a requirement that cannot be verified or satisfied.

T013 (Unit test for null handling) is marked as missing/rejected. This is the only task explicitly assigned to verify US-1 Acceptance Scenario 3 (human_docstring must be null, not empty string). Without this task, FR-001's data integrity requirement is unverified.

T042 (Verify 6-hour runtime limit) is marked as pending. SC-004 requires measuring computational feasibility against the 6-hour constraint. Without a completed task to generate the evidence (logs/perf.log), this critical success criterion has no implementation path.
